modes.local: validated local receipt or full-suite fallback
modes.candidate: validated read-only successful-main receipt or full-suite fallback

digests: complete sorted input file inventory and contents
complete product-suite harness and support inputs
Node platform, version, locale, timezone, pool, and suite
resource profile and worker counts are recorded as planning metadata and excluded from the semantic input digest
proof: Only a successful complete product full-suite run may write the receipt; every consumer recomputes all inputs.
rollback: Delete the disposable receipt or omit its read-only CI mount to force the complete unit suite.
collisionCheck: Atomic replacement is limited to the canonical disposable proof path; immutable CI artifacts retain its SHA-256.
